backdate.title: Change from an earlier day · VC {vc}
backdate.description: For a change that bills already made should have had. Only the owner can do this. Every bill change gets your reason.
backdate.reason_label: Why are you changing old bills?
backdate.reason_hint: A few words, for example: forgot to enter it in September.
backdate.saved: Saved. The bill changes are made.

effect.title: What happens to the bills
effect.same: This is the same plan and rent. Nothing changes.
effect.debit: {month}: ₹{amount} extra will be added to the next bill.
effect.credit: {month}: ₹{amount} less. It is taken off what the customer owes.

reason.not_billed_this_period: {month}: no bill made yet. The bill will use the new rent.
reason.billed_by_run: {month}: the monthly bill will charge it.
reason.start_next_month: {month}: no charge. Rent starts from the next month.
reason.already_charged: {month}: rent is already charged. Nothing more.

effect.billed_staff: Bills for {month} are already made. Ask the owner to change it from this day.
effect.billed_owner: Bills up to {month} are already made. Saving adds a bill change for each month below, with your reason.

error.in_future: The day can't be after today.
error.too_old: That day is too long ago. Check the day.
error.before_start: The day can't be before the connection started.
error.before_last_change: The day can't be before the last change.
error.retired: This plan is not offered any more. Choose another.
error.plan_or_amount: Choose a plan or write an amount.
error.amount: Write the rent in rupees (0 to 1,00,000).
error.invalid_transition: This change is not possible for this connection now.
error.billed_period: Bills for that month are already made. Ask the owner.
error.not_allowed: You can't do this. Ask the owner.
error.read_only: The app is view-only now. Pay the subscription to make changes.
error.not_found: This connection was not found. Open the customer again.
error.id_reused: This form was already saved. Open the list to check.

list.description: Extra charges and discounts after bills were made. Each one has a reason.

manual.title: New bill change
manual.description: Add an extra charge or give a discount on a customer's bills. Only the owner can do this.

manual.credit_hint: Taken off what the customer owes now
manual.reason_hint: A few words, for example: repair visit, cable was cut for 10 days.
manual.summary_debit: ₹{amount} extra will be added to {name}'s next bill.
manual.summary_credit: ₹{amount} will be taken off what {name} owes.
